primary_root_cause: The closure traversal's reference set was defined from one incomplete source (envelope refs) while payload-declared ref slots were an equally authoritative source, so bounds were escapable
evidence: "Traversal seeded only from `envelope.artifact_refs`, while nearly every typed payload carries its own `ArtifactRef` slots that nothing required to be mirrored there."

primary_root_cause: A flat campaign-level question list erased which attention owned each question, merging independently varying per-attention question sets into one collection
evidence: "A flat `open_question_ids` could not tell the fold which attention owned a question ... and stranded a resolved attention's questions as permanently open."

primary_root_cause: Entry and exit rules for the suspension phase were unspecified, so late or stale attention events could act on a campaign that had already moved on
evidence: "Leaving `HUMAN_REQUIRED` was not safe against late attention events."

primary_root_cause: A guard was stated unconditionally over all human commands while the schema forbids the referenced field on one of them — two normative statements in direct contradiction
evidence: "The schema forbids `attention_id` on `CANCEL` while `HumanDecisionRecorded` required a referenced attention unconditionally, so the one command FD-14.6 calls unconditional would have been rejected every time."

primary_root_cause: A state field had a consumer but no producing event, leaving the whole question lane unreachable
evidence: "`open_question_ids` existed, and nothing ever put an id in it ... so the `provide_answer` guard could never be satisfied."

primary_root_cause: Limits existed only at the per-object grain with no aggregate or closure-level budget, so the total resolvable size was unbounded
evidence: "Bounds were per-object only. 256 refs × 64 MiB is 16 GiB before the DAG even branches."

primary_root_cause: One reference did not fix which of an artifact's two separately stored byte strings its digest and size identify
evidence: "`ArtifactRef` did not say which of an artifact's two byte strings it identified."

primary_root_cause: Genesis carried only a commitment to the budget policy rather than the values replay needs, so the log was not replay-self-contained
evidence: "a replaying reader could verify that the policy was unchanged without ever learning what it was — while `resolve_event` needs the effective bound at genesis."

primary_root_cause: A deliverable's minimum specification depended on a component scheduled for a later phase, so definitions it cannot run without were absent from its own layer
evidence: "A1-V0 required the reducer A2 was going to write later."

primary_root_cause: One reference field carried two distinct roles — the artifact that authorizes a transition and the artifact that merely supplies provenance for an evidence event — and its typing fit only the first
evidence: "`authority_ref` was untypeable for evidence kinds ... The word \"authority\" no longer has to pretend a `CoderReport` authorizes something."

primary_root_cause: The request to revise a contract and the campaign's later supersession by an actual successor were collapsed into a single transition, one requiring a successor that did not yet exist
evidence: "It moved to `SUPERSEDED`, which requires `superseded_by`, at a moment when the successor campaign did not exist — and then blocked the very `CampaignSuperseded` event that could have named it."

primary_root_cause: A duplicated copy of an enum vocabulary drifted from the source enum it claims to reuse (with a wrong citation range alongside)
evidence: "A1's copy of the vocabulary stopped at `not_applicable` while the enum it claims to reuse carries `error` ... and the citation range was wrong too."

primary_root_cause: Stale text left behind by an earlier refactor: one section still referenced a top-level field another section had already replaced
evidence: "FD-14.6 still spoke of a top-level `open_question_ids` that §3.14 had already deleted in favour of per-attention entries."

primary_root_cause: A single resolution function covered both genesis and non-genesis events although the two differ in what inputs are available, making the signature circular for genesis
evidence: "`resolve_event` took a campaign policy that, for `CampaignCreated`, lives inside the payload the function has yet to read."

primary_root_cause: The mere presence of a receipt was treated as proof of the execution it was supposed to attest; nothing bound the receipt to the artifact and bytes in question
evidence: "Presence of a receipt proved nothing ... A valid receipt from an unrelated execution is now `ReceiptIncongruent`."

primary_root_cause: The provider execution identity had no minting point and the only available field names a different actor's execution, so two distinct execution identities would have been taken for one
evidence: "the envelope's `producer_execution_id` is the *controller's* identity on a controller-issued artifact (FD-10), so it could not be borrowed."

primary_root_cause: Evolving lifecycle state was carried on an immutable content-addressed artifact, merging the fixed request with the changing attention it opens
evidence: "Attention lifecycle mutated an immutable artifact."

primary_root_cause: The reachable-reference definition covered only one node kind while another node kind also reaches artifacts, so those references escaped accounting
evidence: "`immediate_refs` was defined only for envelope-bearing artifacts, while events reach artifacts through `source_ref`, `evidence_refs`, and payload slots."

primary_root_cause: A single label "resumed" stood in for several distinct destination phases, and nothing recorded which one a suspension should return to
evidence: "\"Resumed\" is not a phase, and nothing stored where to return."

primary_root_cause: The reducer's input was specified as the wire event when the transitions operate on the resolved event (verified payload, source artifact, registry views) — two distinct objects named as one
evidence: "A pure, I/O-free function cannot fetch those, so the signature was quietly asking for a magic trick."

primary_root_cause: Attention ids were not fixed as unique for the campaign's lifetime, so one id could denote either a re-raised record or a distinct new attention
evidence: "Attention identity was ambiguous ... leaving \"replace the record\" and \"append a second\" both defensible."

primary_root_cause: Framing constants were referred to but never assigned values, leaving digest computation implementation-defined
evidence: "Four framings said \"tag byte\" with no numbering, so two conforming implementations could pick different bytes and compute different digests."

primary_root_cause: A non-actionable notification was modeled as a suspending, decision-bearing attention, so the mandated V0 path breached the suspension invariant
evidence: "an attention nobody can act on was always a feed item wearing a decision's coat."

primary_root_cause: Terminal transitions omitted canonicalization, leaving fields populated that the state invariant forbids in terminal phases
evidence: "the event that ends a campaign could violate §3.14 on its way out."

primary_root_cause: One stage named `verify` was assigned two different verification scopes — checks decidable from bytes in hand and checks requiring CAS fetches it has no access to
evidence: "`verify` was asked to bound a closure it could not see ... a separate CAS object that only the next stage fetches, and `verify` has no CAS."

primary_root_cause: A mandatory identity field had no defined value for human-originated artifacts, leaving "who accepted the bytes" and "who authored them" undistinguished
evidence: "`producer_execution_id` had no defined value for human artifacts ... the human one being the controller's **ingress** execution identity: who accepted the bytes, never who authored them."

primary_root_cause: An event classified as evidence-only performed a canonical mutation without advancing the version, so a single version number denoted two materially different state revisions
evidence: "`ProviderExecutionRecorded` cleared `active_execution` without advancing `state_version`, so two materially different states could share one version."

primary_root_cause: Receipt congruence never bound the receipt to this campaign's budget policy or this execution's id, so evidence from a foreign execution or policy satisfied the check
evidence: "none compared `receipt.request.budget_policy_digest` to the campaign's, so an execution could run under a foreign budget policy and still pass."

primary_root_cause: The accepted-event set was given only as semantic prose with no wire contract, several names corresponding to no message kind at all
evidence: "`AcceptedEvent` was a list of names, six of which corresponded to no message kind at all, so two conforming implementations could build different logs."

primary_root_cause: Event-carried fields that duplicate reducer-derived values were left unconstrained against the transition that produces them
evidence: "Reducer-owned fields did not have to agree with their own transition."

primary_root_cause: One receipt spanned two grains — a single dispatch and a whole execution — without determining which of them it represented
evidence: "A single receipt carrying one `dispatch_id` beside a whole-execution manifest could not say which grain it represented."

primary_root_cause: A declared limit had no state anywhere tracking the quantity it bounds, making the constraint unenforceable
evidence: "Nothing tracked a cumulative total, so the number was a claim no code could keep."

primary_root_cause: Message schemas were specified by relative reference to another shape instead of complete field tables
evidence: "\"Same shape minus some fields\" is not a wire schema."

primary_root_cause: The artifact-kind set was left incomplete after the enum framing fix, so implementations would have had to invent spellings for digest inputs
evidence: "`ArtifactKindV1` was a partial list."

primary_root_cause: Three transitions set the human-required phase directly, bypassing the single path that establishes that phase's required accompanying state
evidence: "Three transitions entered `HUMAN_REQUIRED` through the back door ... without setting `suspended_from_phase` and without opening an attention."

primary_root_cause: A single flag asserted far more than the underlying observation supports, merging a requester's claimed identity with the controller's transport observation
evidence: "Loopback proves transport, not humanity, identity, or an uncompromised local process."

primary_root_cause: The whole-execution outcome was derived in a way its per-dispatch observations do not support, so the label meaning "nothing was dispatched" could be produced after a real side effect
evidence: "A completed dispatch 0 followed by an unsent continuation derived to `failed_pre_dispatch`, which is exactly the label that would authorize a whole-execution retry."

primary_root_cause: The dispatch slot was cleared unconditionally even when the execution's outcome was ambiguous, so a crash window admitted a redrive the protocol forbids
evidence: "`ProviderExecutionRecorded` cleared `active_execution` unconditionally, so a crash between it and the escalating attention left a state where `WorkOrderIssued` passed its guard and redrove an execution FD-9 forbids redriving."

primary_root_cause: The event wire format was underspecified throughout — a digest framed but never declared, prose payload lists, a partially committed ref, and an unnamed genesis value
evidence: "`event_payload_digest` was framed but never declared; per-kind payloads were prose lists; `source_ref` was committed by digest alone."

primary_root_cause: Stale text from an earlier round still described the ready-to-merge handoff as an attention request, contradicting the sections that had since replaced it
evidence: "§5.5 still called the ready-to-merge handoff an attention request — a leftover from R4, contradicting §3.9 and §5.3."

primary_root_cause: The producer of the evidence also declared which gates counted, so the criterion a green verdict rests on was taken from the same report being judged rather than from the campaign's own required set
evidence: "`results[].required` let a defective controller mark an inconvenient gate as optional and have an honest reducer agree."
